summary: Every Concord tool export returns the ToolResult the host declares. The pinned host reads a string output and splits it without a guard, so returning the raw envelope threw a TypeError and no tool call could succeed. The envelope now travels as JSON text in output as its only carrier, an oversize result becomes a bounded error envelope, the execute boundary drops the concealing any, and the spent TS2322 allowance is removed.
title: Concord tool results are host ToolResults
